entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: The kami of black magic and the fundamental force of power on Kamigawa, one of the most powerful kami.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: A kami who waged war on the mortal world during the Kami War.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: A man given power by the Myojin in exchange for service, later blinded and banished to Dominaria.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: The person to whom Toshi gave That Which Was Taken.

entities.name: That Which Was Taken
entities.description: An object the Myojin wanted kept from O-Kagachi.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Toshiro's descendant, who defeated and killed Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An Elder Dragon who destroyed the Myojin's domains and claimed to have defeated her.

entities.name: Leshrac Nightwalker
entities.description: Given a porcelain mask by the Myojin when she tried to enlist his help against Bolas.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war during which O-Kagachi attacked the mortal world.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: A place on Dominaria where Toshi was dropped off.

events.summary: During the Kami War, the Myojin discovers she can use the wavering planar barriers to travel the multiverse.
events.quote: The Myojin of Night's Reach discovered she could use this to travel across the multiverse

events.summary: To prolong the war, the Myojin gives the cornered Toshiro Umezawa power to defeat his enemies in exchange for his service.
events.quote: she approached Toshiro Umezawa when he was cornered

events.summary: Toshi gives That Which Was Taken to Michiko Konda, ending the Kami War.
events.quote: gave That Which Was Taken to Michiko Konda

events.summary: Night's Reach takes Toshi's eyesight and banishes him to Dominaria.
events.quote: Night's Reach took away Toshi's eyesight and banished him from Kamigawa

events.summary: Toshiro's descendant Tetsuo Umezawa defeats and kills Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: Toshiro's descendant Tetsuo Umezawa would eventually defeat and kill the Elder Dragon Nicol Bolas

events.summary: The Myojin asks Leshrac Nightwalker to help against Bolas and gives him a porcelain mask that draws black mana.
events.quote: She gave him a porcelain mask capable of drawing black mana from his enemies.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas claims to have found and defeated the Myojin, taking her mask, before she fled again.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas later claimed to have found and defeated her, taking her original porcelain mask before she fled again

relations.note: Granted power in exchange for service.
Destroyed her domains and chased her.
relations.quote: Bolas destroyed her domains and turned her worshippers against her
would eventually defeat and kill the Elder Dragon Nicol Bolas
